title: Almond Butter Protein Balls
summary: Almond butter protein balls made with oats and quinoa. A no-bake, toddler-friendly snack that’s naturally nutritious, soft, and perfect for busy families.
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried fruit or chocolate chips
steps: In a large bowl, add all the ingredients. Mix well using a spatula or your hands until evenly combined. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to firm up.
Scoop about 1-2 tablespoons of the mixture and roll into small balls using slightly damp or wet hands.
Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week or in the freezer for up to 3 months.
